chunks.title: About Me
chunks.content: About Me Turning applied AI research into production-ready systems for high-impact applications. AI Engineer focused on Computer Vision, NLP, and Real-Time Inference Systems I build AI systems that bridge cutting-edge research with real-world deployment, specializing in computer vision, natural language processing, and performance-aware inference. I'm a dual-degree graduate in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence from Ain Shams University and the University of East London (Class of 2026, GPA: 3.3/4.0). My flagship work is Shifaa, an AI-powered, privacy-first clinical decision support and patient monitoring platform. I engineered its real-time seizure detection pipeline using Vision Transformers, Graph Neural Networks, OpenPose, ONNX Runtime, C++, and Python, achieving 96.69% AUROC, 90.18% F1-score, and 37+ FPS for low-latency pre-clinical seizure detection. Beyond healthcare AI, I've contributed to NLP research at MAHE, autonomous path planning with the ASU Racing Team, earned the AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty certification, and mentored aspiring AI engineers through ApplAi. I'm currently applying that same engineering mindset to AI automation at Cultiv Bureau, building n8n, RAG, CRM, and API-driven workflows. Computer Vision NLP Healthcare AI Research Leadership

chunks.title: Featured Projects
chunks.content: Featured Projects Flagship AI systems presented as compact case studies for fast technical review. Graduation Project | Healthcare AI Shifaa - AI-Based Patient Monitoring Platform Production-grade, privacy-first hospital monitoring platform unifying a grounded medical AI assistant with real-time detection for cardiac arrhythmia, patient falls, and epileptic seizures. 96.69% AUROC 90.18% F1 37+ FPS PyTorch OpenCV ONNX Runtime C++ Python ViViT GNN OpenPose Repo Demo Paper Problem Hospitals need fast, on-premises patient monitoring without leaking sensitive data. Solution A role-aware interface with three detection pipelines and a grounded medical assistant. Architecture Series-gated ViViT + GNN seizure pipeline with OpenPose, ONNX Runtime, C++, and Python. Results 96.69% AUROC, 90.18% F1-score, 37+ FPS, and pre-clinical seizure alerts. Impact Designed for privacy-first, fully on-premises hospital deployment. Future Work Clinical validation, alert workflow hardening, and broader hospital integrations. 1st Place | CV Course Competition Fruit & Food Segmentation and Calorie Estimation AI-powered food analysis platform integrating segmentation, classification, few-shot recognition, and calorie estimation with an EfficientNet-B4 + DeepLabV3+ model. 97.69% Val IoU 1st Place PyTorch OpenCV Streamlit EfficientNet-B4 DeepLabV3+ Few-shot Recognition Code Live Demo Problem Food analysis needs object-level recognition before calories can be estimated reliably. Solution Segment food regions, classify items, support few-shot recognition, then estimate calories. Results 97.69% Validation IoU and 1st Place in the Ain Shams CV Course Competition. Lessons Strong segmentation quality is the foundation for trustworthy downstream nutrition estimates. Medical Imaging Liver Tumor AI - Real-Time Detection & Segmentation PyTorch + U-Net liver tumor segmentation pipeline for unseen patients using strict patient-level validation. 95% Accuracy 91.7% Dice PyTorch U-Net Medical AI Segmentation Live Demo Code Problem Medical segmentation can look strong while leaking patient data across splits. Solution Patient-independent validation with a U-Net segmentation pipeline. Results 95% accuracy and 91.7% Dice score. Impact Healthcare AI proof point with a deployed demo and reproducible code. NLP Research Article Summarizer Chatbot Conversational summarization and question-generation chatbot using Gemini 2.5 Flash API. Gemini API Streamlit NLP Question Generation ROUGE Evaluation Live Demo Code Paper Problem Readers need fast, contextual summaries and follow-up questions from long articles. Solution A Streamlit chatbot that summarizes, extracts topics, and generates context-aware questions. Research Built during the MAHE internship and connected to an NLP summarization paper. Future Work Add richer evaluation dashboards and source-grounded answer tracing. NASA Space Apps ExoNet - AI-Powered Exoplanet Classifier Residual MLP classifier for NASA K2 exoplanet candidates with SHAP explainability. 95.28% Accuracy PyTorch Residual MLP SHAP Astronomy XAI Code Problem Candidate signals need interpretable classification to support review. Solution Residual MLP classifier paired with SHAP feature attribution. Results 95.28% accuracy in the NASA Space Apps Challenge context. Impact Shows ML breadth beyond healthcare, with explainability in a scientific workflow.
